in_sanskrit.name: Tamang
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of the forest
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Tamang एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Tamang is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Tamra' meaning copper. Tamang is also associated with the God of the forest. It is a unisex name, popular in both Hindu and Nepali cultures.
